name: Ashen Ghoul

telegraph.name: Bone Cleave
telegraph.description: It winds a forearm of fused bone back for a wide, slow cleave.

flavour: It remembers hunger better than it remembers being alive.

name: Grave Slime

telegraph.name: Void Rupture
telegraph.description: The membrane tightens as it gathers a bubble of unmade space.

flavour: Something in it is still digesting.

name: Cinder Imp

telegraph.name: Cinder Slam
telegraph.description: It leaps, both fists wreathed in a furnace-orange glow.

flavour: It laughs with a mouth full of sparks.

name: Rime Wolf

telegraph.name: Glacial Nova
telegraph.description: Frost gathers in its throat until the air turns white.

flavour: The pack moves like one animal with too many legs.

name: Slag Golem

telegraph.name: Crushing Slam
telegraph.description: Both slag fists rise overhead. Step out of the shadow.

flavour: Every step leaves a scar in the canyon floor.

name: Hollow Reaper

telegraph.name: Grave Harvest
telegraph.description: The scythe traces a slow arc that seems to bend toward your ribs.

flavour: It harvests what the war left standing.

telegraph.name: Soul Wail
telegraph.description: Its mouth opens too wide, and the cathedral answers.

name: Ash Bat

telegraph.name: Wing Buffet
telegraph.description: It folds its wings, then snaps them wide in a burst of hot ash.

flavour: The swarm is the threat, not the animal.

name: Bone Champion

telegraph.name: Bone Cleave
telegraph.description: It raises a notched blade and holds it there, patient.

flavour: Somebody gave it orders once. It still follows them.

name: Horned Brute

telegraph.name: Crushing Slam
telegraph.description: It lowers its horns and stamps once, twice, then charges.

flavour: It wears the horns of things it has beaten.

name: Void Lich

telegraph.name: Soul Wail
telegraph.description: It draws a sigil in the air and the sigil draws back.

flavour: Its robes are stitched from the space between stars.

name: Demon Sovereign

telegraph.name: Cinder Slam
telegraph.description: It points, and a column of embers begins to fall.

flavour: It rules a canyon that is only partly here.

name: Ashen Warden

telegraph.name: Grave Cleave
telegraph.description: The warden drags its blade through the ash and raises it overhead.

telegraph.name: Bone Prison
telegraph.description: Ribs of old stone close around your arm. Guard it or slow your swings.

flavour: A warbound that never found a wielder. It made its own.

name: Ember Colossus

telegraph.name: Cinder Slam
telegraph.description: The canyon floor glows white before the fist comes down.

telegraph.name: Magma Eruption
telegraph.description: Vents split the floor. The next blow erupts beneath your feet.

flavour: It was forged to end a war. It never stopped.

name: Glacial Archon

telegraph.name: Astral Shatter
telegraph.description: The ice underfoot sings one long note, then breaks.

telegraph.name: Astral Shatter
telegraph.description: A second shatter answers the first, faster and colder.

flavour: The last hymn of the frozen congregation.
